name: llc-illuminated-manuscript-border-kit
scale: native 1x; scale by integer factors only with image-rendering: pixelated
no_motifs: no vines, no leaves; scrollwork, volutes, lozenges, pearls, medallions only

css.strip_right: same with right:0 and vine-strip-right.png (exact mirror)
css.divider_row: [line-tile repeat-x] + divider-top.png (centred, 160px) + [line-tile repeat-x]; the tile is mirror-symmetric so the same file serves both sides

files.usage: left hero edge: background:url() repeat-y left top; start under the TL corner (y=64) and stop above the BL corner. Row 0 is a node apex so it butts cleanly against a corner.
exact horizontal mirror of the left strip; right hero edge, background-position: right top
top-left corner flourish; rails (3px, x/y 2-4) run off the right/bottom edge to join strips and divider line tiles

files.tile: centre piece; extend left/right with divider-line-tile (160 is a multiple of 16)
files.usage: centre under the top rail between the two top corners; hangs from a 3px rail
exact vertical mirror of divider-top, for the bottom edge
rail + pearl line; repeat-x either side of the divider ornament (use the same tile both sides, it is mirror-symmetric); flip vertically for the bottom edge
lozenge gem; bullet/section marker, chain between dividers
round jewelled medallion; centre-piece above/below the logo
twin-volute scroll finial; top-centre cap or section ending
CSS steps(6) animation; position over gold (gems, rails)

qa: python3 lint.py (alpha, palette, isolated pixels, mirrors, tile seams, joins; writes checks/*.png)
